title: land's siblings step runs a sibling's long check once per tree, not again on the second pass
goal: land reuses a passing sibling check result for the same tree on its second pass (after wait-merge), so a 18-minute multi fitness check runs once per landing; SP-3pvz2noj: BG-e2hfeycb's landing ran the siblings step twice, 1080 s and 1066 s

run:
import sys
sys.path.insert(0, '_tools')
import inspect, bl_land
assert 'siblings' in inspect.getsource(bl_land) and 'reuse' in inspect.getsource(bl_land), 'siblings checks rerun on the second pass'
